# OSGi Email Service

> An OSGi-based email service for Apache Karaf that provides a clean API for sending templated emails with Handlebars templates, attachments, and inline content, fully configurable via OSGi Config Admin.

Key facts:
- Java 21 (Zulu JDK), Maven 3.9+ multi-module project (4 modules)
- OSGi Declarative Services component model with Metatype configuration
- Spring Mail (JavaMailSender) for SMTP transport, Handlebars for email templating
- Deploys as Apache Karaf features; integration-tested in a real Karaf container via Pax Exam
- Apache License 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with architecture diagrams and module details
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, technology stack, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and contribution guidelines

## Modules

- [osgi-email-api/pom.xml](osgi-email-api/pom.xml): Service interface (`EmailService`) and builder-pattern DTOs (`EmailMessage`, `BinaryAttachment`) — no external dependencies
- [osgi-email-impl/pom.xml](osgi-email-impl/pom.xml): Implementation using Spring Mail and Handlebars templating, plus `JavaMailSenderActivator` (SMTP config) and `LogSmtpServer` (embedded test SMTP)
- [osgi-email-karaf-features/src/main/feature/feature.xml](osgi-email-karaf-features/src/main/feature/feature.xml): Karaf feature descriptor declaring the `osgi-email` feature and its dependencies
- [osgi-email-itest/pom.xml](osgi-email-itest/pom.xml): Pax Exam integration tests running in a real Karaf 4.4.7 container against the embedded SubEthaSMTP server
